candidate_relations.reason: The biopsies show bland, cleftlike lymphatic channels dissecting dermal collagen without epithelioid endothelial cells, supporting benign lymphangioendothelioma rather than epithelioid hemangioma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct benign vascular neoplasm with epithelioid endothelial morphology.

candidate_relations.reason: Although hemosiderin and lymphatic markers can overlap, the record describes an extensive dermal proliferation of bland channels with promontory signs and does not describe the characteristic hobnail endothelial morphology of hobnail hemangioma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct benign vascular lesion also known as targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma.

candidate_relations.reason: Histology shows thin-walled, irregular lymphatic-type channels positive for D2-40, without arterialized vessels or direct artery-to-vein communications, making arteriovenous malformation a different entity.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: High-flow vascular malformation composed of abnormal arterial and venous structures.
